articles.title: RBI flags suspicious off-market deals in state bonds
articles.description: The Reserve Bank of India is investigating suspicious trading activities involving illiquid state development loans in September. Some traders allegedly tried to manipulate prices to mitigate quarter-end mark-to-market losses for their banks. Transactions involved circular trading between banks to create artificial price support during rising bond yields. Concerns have also emerged regarding unusual trades in a central government security with a long maturity.

articles.title: Fake gold with real hallmark? How 'invisible Mr India' Chinese rhenium powder is allegedly being used to sell impure gold
articles.description: Concerns about fake gold are being raised amid allegations that Chinese rhenium powder is being used to increase the weight of gold jewellery without proportionately increasing its purity. A recent report found that an ornament containing the metal passed certain routine purity checks and received a 22-carat hallmark. Buyers are advised to verify HUID details and purchase jewellery from trusted sellers.

articles.title: Fed tells regional staff to expect lower pay hikes in 2027
articles.description: The budget set by the Fed’s Board of Governors in Washington, which would also apply to its 12 regional reserve banks, would set the minimum salary increase at 1% in 2027, the memo said.

articles.title: California Summons Nvidia Over Concerns About Former CEO, China Ties
articles.description: The probe will help determine whether Nvidia's actions violated California law, attorney general said.

articles.title: IAS officer with 64 villas: Shikhar Agrawal's family buys 24 Jaipur properties at 81% discount, seeks relief from ACB probe; Rajasthan HC denies
articles.description: Rajasthan High Court has declined interim protection to IAS officer Shikhar Agrawal in an ACB investigation into his family’s purchase of 64 villas and cottages from a resort company. The case follows an earlier government action placing Agrawal and his IPS officer wife on Awaiting Posting Orders amid allegations of corruption.

articles.title: Noel Tata to push alternative plan at Tata Sons board meeting
articles.description: Noel Tata plans to present an alternative restructuring proposal for Tata Sons at the November 26 board meeting. He aims to push for transparency regarding the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) directives on listing requirements. The Tata Trusts are also advocating for changes to preserve Tata Sons' unlisted status through mergers. A legal opinion has suggested compliance with RBI is necessary, complicating the situation.

articles.title: 'Insatiable appetite for sops': PM Narendra Modi asks corporate India to deliver on quality in sharp message
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the importance of prioritizing India in business decisions during the centenary celebrations of Ficci. He criticized companies for failing to pass on benefits of reforms to employees and consumers. Modi urged industry leaders to focus on quality and seize global trade opportunities. He called for respect towards Indian consumers and emphasized self-reliance.

articles.title: Talent poaching, data leaks and a 'spy' row roil Tamil Nadu-Andhra investment battle
articles.description: A significant rivalry has developed between Tamil Nadu's Guidance and Andhra Pradesh's Economic Development Board over corporate investments. Allegations of talent poaching and data leaks have intensified the competition between the two states. As resignations were reported from Guidance, several employees migrated to the EDB for better opportunities. Efforts to attract investors have led to increased tensions, including alleged surveillance activities.

articles.description: Concerns over a potential AI bubble and a credit event involving hyperscalers have surged in November, together accounting for 65% of global fund managers' biggest tail-risk concerns, against 34% in October.

articles.title: Piyush Goyal calls for trusted, resilient supply chains between India & US
articles.description: Piyush Goyal underscored the need for resilient and trusted supply chains between India and the US. He highlighted significant economic cooperation opportunities amid global uncertainties affecting both nations. Goyal noted that India offers trust and partnership in times of crisis, making it a reliable ally. He announced India's ambitious $1 trillion export target for the year, indicating strong growth in challenging circumstances.

articles.title: ‘I cut income tax, did you raise salaries?’: PM Modi's sharp jibe at India INC
articles.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the FICCI Annual General Meeting and Annual Convention, urging Indian industry leaders to translate government tax relief and ease-of-doing-business reforms into tangible benefits for employees. Highlighting the reduction in the basic corporate tax rate from 30% to 22% and income tax relief for individuals earning up to ₹12 lakh under the new tax regime, PM Modi asked India Inc whether it had increased employee salaries or expanded its workforce. He also made a pointed remark to industry leaders, saying, ‘Modi ji, you do it, we'll see.’

articles.title: India working to resolve bulk Scotch duty dispute under UK trade pact
articles.description: The Indian government is working to resolve the classification issue surrounding bulk Scotch under the India-UK trade agreement. Customs investigators are imposing a 150% import duty on bulk Scotch, while a 75% rate is offered by the trade pact. The dispute centers around how to classify bulk Scotch imports for customs purposes. Officials are examining which tariff headings apply to these shipments causing significant ambiguity.

articles.title: EPFO New Rule: Withdraw Up to 90% of Your PF Savings and Get Regular Payouts
articles.description: The Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation has reduced the mandatory minimum balance members must retain in their PF accounts from 25% to 10%, allowing eligible subscribers to withdraw up to 90% of their savings.

articles.title: Wassily Kandinsky's painting Betonte Ecken sold for $85.8 million at a November 17 New York auction, almost doubling the artist's previous $44.8 million record as Christie's evening sale brought in $627 million
articles.description: Wassily Kandinsky’s painting Betonte Ecken achieved a record-breaking price of $85.8 million at Christie’s New York. The auction event generated a total of $627 million and included numerous notable artworks. Competitive bidding was evident, with multiple collectors participating for high-value pieces. Other artists like Gustav Klimt and Pablo Picasso also saw substantial sales. The results indicate a vibrant market for modern and Impressionist art continues to thrive.

articles.description: Scheduled for November 19, 2026, in Delhi, the 240th meeting of the EPFO's Central Board of Trustees aims to tackle crucial agenda items, such as boosting the minimum EPS pension beyond Rs 1,000.
